contract.gap: Required distance: sum of half-thickness interpolated at closest midsurface witnesses
contract.topology: Exclude point if a face corner; exclude edge pairs sharing a vertex. No other exclusions.
contract.edges: Sorted unique union of every face edge and explicit cord segment; endpoints sorted by ID
contract.comparison: Compare canonical pair identity sets, distances and gaps; independent of grid enumeration order
contract.scope: Discrete Find only, not swept broad phase or correctness of the variable-radius material model
